paper.title_en: Spherically symmetric inextendibility of weak null singularities with Christoffel symbols in $L^s_{\text{loc}}$
paper.abstract_en: Motivated by the strong cosmic censorship conjecture in general relativity, we prove the inextendibility of spherically symmetric weak null singularities as spherically symmetric Lorentzian manifolds with a continuous metric and Christoffel symbols in $L^{s}_{\text{loc}}$ for $s>1$. The result assumes a suitable blow-up condition on the derivative of the area-radius function transverse to the weak null singularity in combination with a rigidity result on continuous spherically symmetric extensions across null boundaries proven in [1]. In particular we show that these assumptions are satisfied by the Reissner-Nordström-Vaidya spacetime as well as by a class of spacetimes arising from small and generic spherically symmetric perturbations of subextremal Reissner-Nordström under the Einstein-Maxwell-scalar field system.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究广义相对论中的强宇宙监督猜想，涉及弱零奇异性的不可延拓性，属于广义相对论基础领域，具有理论深度和方法论价值。
decision.title_zh: 具有Christoffel符号在$L^s_{\text{loc}}$中的球对称弱零奇异性的不可延拓性
decision.abstract_zh: 受广义相对论中强宇宙监督猜想的启发，我们证明了球对称弱零奇异性作为具有连续度量和Christoffel符号在$L^{s}_{\text{loc}}$（$s>1$）中的球对称洛伦兹流形的不可延拓性。该结果假设了面积半径函数在弱零奇异性上横向导数的一个适当的爆破条件，并结合了文献[1]中证明的关于跨零边界的连续球对称延拓的刚性结果。特别地，我们证明了这些假设被Reissner-Nordström-Vaidya时空以及一类在爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量场系统下由亚极端Reissner-Nordström的小且一般的球对称扰动所产生的时空所满足。
